meta.requirement: Explore Dawn Winery (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: Tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Hikers
start.text:
''You notice them from a distance, because the packs notice you first.''

''Two travelers are moving at a steady, deliberate pace along the road near the winery. What they are carrying defies reasonable expectation. Each pack is a towering construction of reinforced leather and metal framing, bristling with adjustment clips and load distribution straps. The frames alone could shelter a small family of birds.''

''They are not struggling. That is what stops you. They are just walking.''

Tariq: ''glancing over, catching your expression'' You are doing the maths.

''He adjusts a shoulder strap without breaking stride.''

Tariq: Everyone does.

You_make_them_yourselves.text:
Lena: Materials and a flat surface. ''gestures at the winery behind you'' We are resting here a few days anyway. If you brought us what we need, we could put one together for you.

Tariq: Proper traveler's pack. Frame and all. You would be carrying double your current limit. ''pauses thoughtfully'' Twenty kilograms.

''He is about to continue when something shifts in the vines above the road.''

''Both hikers stop.''

''A branch cracks. Then another. Two hilichurls drop from the ridge directly onto the road, clubs raised, cutting off the path. One of them tilts its mask and makes a low sound at the back of its throat.''

Lena: ''very quietly, not moving'' These packs weigh sixty kilograms combined.

Tariq: ''equally quiet'' We are not running.

Lena: ''looking at you, level and direct'' Are you any good at this?

choices.label: I can hold them. Stay back

How_are_you_carrying_those.text:
Tariq: Training. ''pats the pack frame'' This is twenty-eight kilograms. Weighted travel pack. You load it heavy and keep walking until your body forgets to argue.

Lena: ''from several steps ahead, not looking back'' Thirty-two today. Added stones.

Tariq: ''quietly, to you'' She adds stones to increase the difficulty. We have different philosophies.

''He lengthens his stride slightly to keep pace.''

Tariq: The real advantage is not just the strength. It is the capacity. Build up to a frame like this and you can carry twice your current limit without slowing down. Most travelers stop at ten kilograms because nobody shows them the right equipment. The frame matters more than anything else.

Lena: ''finally stopping and turning'' We build them. The packs. Custom frames.

''She studies you the way a craftsman looks at a problem they might be able to solve.''

choices.label: Where would I even get one?

Get_behind_me.text:
''Tariq moves without a word, stepping to the side of the road and setting a hand on Lena's arm. She follows his lead, shifting back.''

''The two hilichurls advance. They are not in a hurry. They have the numbers, or they think they do.''

''They have not accounted for you.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Protect the hikers from the hilichurls at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click Protect the Hikers. Defeat the 2 [[Hilichurl]]s

afterkillimg.text:
''The hilichurls do not get up.''

''For a moment, the only sound is the wind through the winery vines. Somewhere above the ridge, a bird resumes an interrupted song as if the whole business never happened.''

''Tariq exhales slowly. He has not put his pack down. He did not put it down during the fight.''

''He looks at the hilichurls on the road. He looks at you.''

Tariq: ''choosing his words with care'' ...That was remarkably effective.

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click Talk to the Hikers.

killed.text:
''Lena is already checking her straps, running a hand along each buckle with practiced efficiency.''

Lena: Intact. ''to Tariq'' You?

Tariq: A bruise on my forearm. I caught a vine. ''to you'' Are you hurt?

''He is genuinely asking, not just saying it.''

Im_fine.text:
Tariq: Good. ''pause'' We have been on paths like this for years and it still happens. Miscalculation, an inattentive stretch of road.

Lena: ''standing, rolling one shoulder slowly'' We owe you. ''matter-of-fact, like noting a ledger entry'' You stepped in without being asked. That counts for something.

Tariq: ''slight smile'' She means that as a compliment. It takes her a moment to arrive at them.

You_would_have_managed.text:
Lena: ''standing straighter'' We can pay it back properly.

''She and Tariq exchange a look. The wordless kind, worn smooth by years of shared roads.''

Lena: The pack we mentioned. We will build it for you.

Tariq: The labor is on us. In thanks. ''holds up a hand'' We do need materials, but that is where our part of it ends.

''He pulls a worn notebook from an outer pocket and flips to a page that is dense with small, precise handwriting.''

what_u_need.text:
Tariq: One hundred and fifty Silver. That covers the metal reinforcement plates and tool wear. ''taps the page'' And ten portions of Slime Condensate. It is for the adhesive compound. Makes the strap joints hold their shape without going brittle in the cold.

Lena: ''flatly, as though this is simply a fact'' It is a very good pack. Better than anything at a standard shop. We are quite good at this.

Tariq: ''without a trace of irony'' She is not wrong.

I_will_get_them.text:
Tariq: We will be at the winery. Take your time.

''He glances at the hilichurl clubs still lying on the road. Then at you.''

Tariq: ''quietly'' Thank you. For what you did back there.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 150 Silver and 10 Slime Condensate to the hikers at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click Return to the Hikers

return_to_hikers.text:
''Tariq looks up from a length of metal banding he is measuring against a leather strap. Lena is nearby, laying out flat strips of reinforced hide in order of thickness. They have clearly been working for a while.''

Tariq: Back. ''simply'' Did you bring them?

give_items.text:
''Tariq counts the Silver without rushing. Lena takes the Slime Condensate, opens one of the vials, and tips it slightly to check the consistency. She nods.''

Lena: Good quality. ''to Tariq'' We can start the adhesive layer tonight.

Tariq: ''pocketing the Silver'' Three hours for the frame work and drying time. ''looks up'' We will send the finished pack ahead with our contact in Mondstadt. Her name is Sura. She runs the tanner's stall near the craftsmen's district. Easier than carting it back here if you are already traveling.

''He sets the metal banding aside and begins sorting the Condensate.''

Tariq: Come back in three hours. We will tell you when to go find her.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to the hikers at Dawn Winery in 3 hours. Your bag is being crafted

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, and after that do /rpg and click Check on the Bag

still_gather.text:
Tariq: ''nods, unhurried'' Take your time. We are not going anywhere yet.

''He goes back to the metal banding. Lena holds a strip of hide up to the light to check its grain.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 150 Silver and 10 Slime Condensate to the hikers at Dawn Winery

chek_on_bag.text:
''Tariq is making small, precise adjustments to something in his hands, a compact metal frame assembly, the finished junction points. He does not look up when you approach.''

Tariq: Right on time.

''He turns. The frame is complete. Every joint is clean, every strap termination doubled. It is, by any reasonable measure, a very well-made piece of equipment.''

Tariq: We sent the pack body ahead last night. Sura has it. ''Craftsmen's district, tanner's stall.'' Tell her Tariq sent you, she will know which one.

''He folds his notebook closed with a soft click.''

Tariq: It will serve you well. ''looks at you directly'' Twenty kilograms capacity, proper distribution. You will not feel the difference until you try to carry something large.

Lena: ''already reassembling her own pack from the other side of the road, without looking up'' Try not to add stones.

Tariq: ''to you, just barely audible'' She is the finest traveler I have ever known and the most stubborn person I have ever met. These two things are directly connected.

Thank_you_Both_of_you.text:
''Lena stands and settles her straps with one practiced motion.''

Lena: You did not have to step in on that road. ''a brief, level nod'' Don't lose the frame.

Tariq: Safe travels. ''lifts his pack, settles the weight evenly across his shoulders'' Perhaps we will cross paths again. The roads are long.

''They move off together down the winery path, packs enormous, pace easy. Tariq's notebook disappears into an outer pocket. Lena is already watching the tree line.''

''You watch them go until they round the corner.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Collect your bag from Sura at the craftsmen's district in Mondstadt

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt) and then do /rpg and click Collect Your Bag

collec_bag.text:
''The craftsmen's district is easy enough to find. The tanner's stall is the one with the smell of cured leather and the precisely stacked rolls of hide near the entrance. A compact, efficient woman is sorting samples at the counter.''

Sura: ''without looking up'' Help you?

''You mention Tariq.''

Sura: ''pausing, setting down the sample she is holding'' Ah. ''she reaches under the counter'' He left word you would be coming.

''She lifts out a pack. Clean lines, reinforced frame junctions, doubled strap terminations. Well-made in exactly the way Tariq described.''

Sura: ''handing it across'' He asked me to tell you, and I am quoting directly: use the outer pockets for weight balance, not storage.

choices.label: That sounds like something he would say

bag_collected.title: Bag Collected
bag_collected.text:
''Sura allows herself a brief smile.''

Sura: He is thorough. ''back to her samples'' Safe travels.

''You step out of the stall and into the craftsmen's district with the pack over one arm. It is heavier than it looks, built to carry weight rather than just hold it.''

''Somewhere out on the road from Dawn Winery, Tariq and Lena are probably already walking.''
